title: What does NFTokenAcceptOffer do on XRPL?
abstract: Sourced explanation of NFTokenAcceptOffer and its practical limits.
body:
According to XRPL documentation, NFTokenAcceptOffer completes an NFT trade by accepting a buy offer, a sell offer or a compatible brokered pair. [1]

The transaction references existing offer identifiers rather than creating a new asking price. A brokered trade can include a broker fee under the matching rules. Check token identity, currency, issuer, destination restrictions and offer expiration before signing. Acceptance settles the listed trade; an offer's existence alone does not transfer ownership. [1]

The NFTokenAcceptOffer reference defines the operation-specific fields alongside the shared XRPL transaction fields. Account identifies the submitting account; signing authority, transaction cost and sequence handling still have to satisfy the ledger rules. A submitted transaction or an example in documentation does not establish a successful validated result. Where an amendment is required, confirm it is enabled on the intended network before relying on the feature. [1][2]

Author interpretation: before using NFTokenAcceptOffer, compare the intended change with the current ledger state and keep the transaction hash with the resulting metadata. Treat unresolved outcomes as unresolved; submitting a replacement operation can create a second obligation. These are integration recommendations, not a report of a live test. Sources accessed 10 November 2026.
